title: Beyond Relational: Semantic-Aware Multi-Modal Analytics with LLM-Native Query Optimization

statements.text: Suppose that a model $m_a$ is more intelligent and costly than a model $m_b$. Then, choosing $m_a$ over $m_b$ as the execution engine for an operator in a plan improves the overall result quality (but at higher cost), regardless of the models allocated to other operators in the plan.

Given the ground-truth result $y$ to a query $x$, if a model $m$ returns a correct answer $y$ to $x$, $m(x)=y$, any model $m^ + $ that is more powerful than $m$ also returns the right answer $y$, $m^ + (x)=y$.
